findings.summary: Gate check-failure contract underspecified: name gate value/code, routing order before single-task/Find-RunnerWaveFailure fallbacks, baseline-fail interaction, per-task gate calls run only checks of tasks whose files are in -Files; add two-task-wave one-check-fails test.
findings.fix: check failure returns gate='accept', code=1, failing_task_id, output_tail; :1167-1170 routing uses failing_task_id first; checks run only when baseline passes; gate runs only checks for tasks in -Files.

findings.summary: Tail storage unspecified; overwriting diagnosis would break :1059-1063 crash-resume and ladder keyed on 'verification failure'.
findings.fix: separate optional attempt field acceptance_output_tail saved with status/diagnosis; diagnosis string unchanged; Start-RunnerAttempt reads tail from most recent prior failed attempt; crash-after-failure resume test; schema field (attempt additionalProperties:false).

findings.summary: Teardown adoption must use Test-EngineLedgerRowLive (engine-dispatch.ps1:385) and Invoke-EngineAdopt (engine-dispatch.ps1:912-945), not ad hoc wrapper calls or attempt.child_pid only.
findings.fix: live row -> refuse; else Invoke-EngineAdopt with attempt spec/task/worktree and child_output path under run dir; re-read row; adopt_timed_out, non-zero, or still non-terminal -> refuse; tests for adopt timeout and live row pid.

findings.summary: Complete-run discard must bypass the hand-off journal check and Test-EngineTeardownProof (:1456-1464), else the repair flow fails; -Reason missing from param block.
findings.fix: complete+Discard bypasses journal and proof; add [string]$Reason param, rejected unless -Teardown -Discard; reason check before any adoption side effect; test where main HEAD differs from tip and discard succeeds.

findings.summary: Absolute-path / location-command grammar undefined; planner and validator can drift (/dev/null, bare '/', regex literals, UNC, forward-slash drive paths).
findings.fix: define the rule once with test vectors (drive-letter X:\ or X:/, UNC \\, token starting with '/'; cd/Set-Location/Push-Location whole word in command position); both test files carry identical accept/refuse vectors.

findings.summary: No per-check timeout; a hanging check blocks the Engine holding run lock, wave pin, staged index.
findings.fix: bounded per-check timeout via Start-Process + WaitForExit, kill process tree on expiry, failed check with 'timed out' tail; engine-test case.

findings.summary: Spec-level window's files, residue inventory, and pin label unspecified; reusing final wave inventory would falsely flag earlier waves.
findings.fix: reuse Invoke-RunnerGate sequence with distinct label engine-<run>-spec; residue check over Get-RunnerAllFiles and last wave inventory; pin/movement failure sets spec_acceptance.status='failed' before parking; Resume re-run clears old tail.

findings.summary: Label grammar undefined: compound labels, HOST/non-manifest task IDs, incidental Task mentions (Get-EngineAcceptanceLines :391 matches anywhere).
findings.fix: label = leading '^- \[[ xX]\] Task (\d+[a-z]?) -'; compound label refused for tagged blocks; non-manifest ID refused as unknown; host_checks records label verbatim.

findings.summary: Next text undefined for refused, running/paused, and teardown-refusal on complete (:1773).
findings.fix: define fallthrough (refused -> 'Next: fix inputs and start a new run'), failed-teardown wording; summary tests for refused and torn-down.

findings.summary: Grep evidence uses literal <pattern> placeholder; rg misses files under the blanket-gitignored .claude tree.
findings.fix: real search strings per file; --no-ignore/-uu or path-scoped commands.
